blocks.purpose: 16 MiB external AXI target; controller/PHY excluded
read and write DMA including the buffered output write burst
4096-byte activation store, weight transfer buffer and operand sequencing; holds no output buffer
four signed-byte products, grouped INT32 sum; flushed by dot_lifecycle
passive core; separate unreleased S1 port supplement

axi4.dut_initiator_offer_order: CPU and NPU AWVALID offered no later than first WVALID of same transaction, independently of AWREADY; target still tolerates W handshake before AW

native.semantics: SYS-13: core holds mem_valid and payload until the edge sampling mem_ready=1; mem_wstrb=0 read, !=0 write (8 legal strobe patterns); bridge asserts mem_ready one cycle per transfer, registered (never same cycle as mem_valid rise), never while mem_valid=0, mem_rdata valid in that cycle; failing request gets no mem_ready (SYS-07); mem_valid need not drop between transfers; one transfer live

dispatch.semantics: NPU-09(a): valid/ready, one command live, each recipient sees it once; accepted handshake re-arms the recipient (discard buffers, partial state, offered-but-unaccepted output beats, held dma_terminal level); npu_local ready=1 whenever not in reset; C25 (local) completes no later than C13 (dma), same edge permitted; dma first AR from the cycle after its own handshake

local_bytes.semantics: NPU-09(a): valid/ready, payload stable when stalled; kind 0 activation / 1 weight, index = 4-aligned first k, row = n (0 for activation), keep[b]=1 iff k=index+b<K; consumer ready=0 until its dispatch handshake; producer forwards no fetched data after its first DMA error (NPU-06) except beats already offered

group_result.semantics: NPU-09(b,d): valid/ready, one INT32 result per group, last = dot_operands.command_last forwarded; producer never asserts valid while dot_lifecycle.flush=1; consumer holds ready=0 from its first DMA non-OKAY response until its next dispatch handshake

dot_operands.semantics: command_last iff group_last and final descriptor row/group; forwarded to group_result.last

terminal.semantics: valid/ready, exactly one record per terminal edge; cycles = T-H+1 per NPU-04 (H = C12 handshake edge, T = dma_terminal sampling edge)

dma_terminal.semantics: NPU-09(c): no handshake; done/error/error_code are registered levels set on the producer terminal edge, exactly one of done/error, error_code 5 or 6 while error=1 else 0, held until the edge on which the producer next dispatch handshake (C13) completes or reset; consumer samples only from the cycle after its own C13 handshake, first edge with done|error=1 is the terminal edge T, no re-sampling for the same command

fault_event.semantics: sticky until common reset; no READY; earliest edge then lowest reason
fault_event.known_address: aligned matching AR/AW address retained once offered or accepted

stop_issue.semantics: sticky; preserve all previously offered VALID and their associated W/R/B work

cpu_clock_reset.semantics: wrapper sticky fault metadata resets only by common rst_n; PicoRV32 core resets by cpu_local_rst_n; bridge unaffected by local reset

dot_lifecycle.semantics: NPU-09(b): registered level driven by npu_ctl; 1 from reset release and from the edge sampling dma_terminal done|error, 0 from the edge on which the next npu_local dispatch handshake (C25) completes (still 1 in the cycle ending at that edge); while 1 npu_dot clears result register and accumulator, holds group_result.valid=0, presents dot_operands.ready=1 and discards accepted operand beats

owner_modules_semantics: owner_modules is the verification-scope participation list for a requirement (every module whose behaviour the requirement constrains); implemented_by, where present, names the module that realises the mechanism (rc4, ISSUE-cpu_bridge-02)
port_identifier_convention: RTL ports of internal ICD protocols are named <i_|o_><protocol>_<field> (e.g. i_dispatch_x_base, o_group_result_last, o_dot_lifecycle_flush); full/Lite AXI ports <m_|s_>axi_<signal lowercase>; clock/reset i_clk, i_rst_n, i_cpu_local_rst_n; single-signal protocols whose field name is globally unique may drop the protocol prefix (i_stop_new_transactions). Binding for protocols added from rc4 on; rc3 port spellings are reconciled in the top-level port map, not renamed (rc4, ISSUE-npu_dma-01)
